item.title: Augusta man charged with killing stepfather in domestic dispute
item.description: Richmond County investigators say a domestic incident that turned violent led to a fatal shooting Sunday evening on the 3400 block of Lucie Street. The post Augusta man charged with killing stepfather in domestic dispute appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: All public schools to have naloxone by spring
item.description: In a nod to the spread of opioids, Georgia is installing overdose reversal kits at all 2,300 public schools in the state using money from a legal settlement with the pharmaceutical industry. The post All public schools to have naloxone by spring appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: SRS Fire Department hosts DOE fire chiefs for three-day benchmarking visit
item.description: The Savannah River Site Fire Department hosted fire chiefs from across the Department of Energy complex for a three-day benchmarking and training visit aimed at improving fire safety practices and strengthening emergency response coordination. The post SRS Fire Department hosts DOE fire chiefs for three-day benchmarking visit appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Aiken woman fakes car theft, collects $15K in insurance payout
